title: Recursive Superintelligence signs $410 compute deal with Amazon
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: Recursive’s $400 million outlay represents the bulk of the company’s fundraising to date.
body: Recursive Superintelligence has signed a $410 million compute partnership with Amazon Web Services to build next-generation self-improving foundation models. The multi-year deal will leverage AWS's custom Trainium and Inferentia accelerator clusters to train models capable of recursive self-modification. This compute capacity is key to the startup's mission of developing general-purpose reasoning agents. By partnering with AWS, the company secures reliable access to high-performance computing infrastructure needed to train models at an unprecedented scale. This partnership signals a strong collaboration between AWS and AI startups.
